excluded_columns: Unnumbered columns at weeks 6, 10, 14, 18, 22, 26, 30, 34, 38, 42, 46 and 50 (page 13): IMP administration only - footnote f (page 16) says the IMP is given every 2 weeks at the patient's home or in a health care facility.
EXACT (page 15): 'Every day (diary) from screening to week 52' - daily e-diary at home, not a visit procedure.
At-home spirometry (FEV1), optional, US/Canada only (page 15): twice-daily home measurements, not a visit procedure.
warnings: Pages 18-19 hold Section 1.3.2, the schedule for patients who stop treatment early; it was not used for the planned visits.
Footnote a (page 16): visit windows are +/-1 week (screening), +/-3 days (treatment period) and +/-5 days (post-treatment).
Footnote f (page 16): after Week 8, IMP injections not done at home are given at the site as unscheduled visits (not modelled here).
2 procedure label(s) are not in the controlled vocabulary and were kept as other:<label>: COPD exacerbation reporting by the Investigator, Smoking status.
